mpljs in the browser · exact vector

The same layout engine, live

This chart is drawn by mpljs running in your browser. Every frame re-runs matplotlib's layout for the current view, so ticks, labels and the legend are exactly what matplotlib would choose. Text is glyph outlines placed at the same positions the PNG renderer uses, and the result is sharp at any zoom.

Hover to read values. Drag to pan, and let go to glide. Click the chart, then scroll to zoom around the cursor (or hold ⌘/Ctrl, or pinch). Shift-drag zooms to a range; double-click resets. From the keyboard: ← → step through the data (Shift for bigger steps), + − zoom, 0 resets.

Traced, end to end

Every frame is one OpenTelemetry-shaped trace, from the input event that caused it to the end of the browser's rendering work for it, with mpljs's layout and SVG spans nested inside. Startup is a trace too, from navigation to the first rendered frame. Click a row for its attributes.
